summary: All targeted scenarios pass. The change adds a 'Build methodology' section to ship briefs via bin/fm-brief.sh, updates the DOD comparison logic in tests/fm-task-delivery.test.sh, and adds the test_ship_build_methodology test. R1 fix addresses the greploop conditional completion contract. R2, R3, R4 are declined and not part of this change. Baseline test failure was caused by untracked ReviewOutput.json file.
tested: rm ReviewOutput.json (untracked file blocking test runner)
testing_summary: Drove 9 scenarios against the real product: methodology section scaffolds into briefs for all 3 delivery modes (no-mistakes, direct-PR, local-only), follows Definition of done ordering, stays under 15 lines, contains all required beats (Isolate, Build, Prove, Ship, unslop), greploop is conditional per R1 fix, scout/secondmate briefs correctly exclude the methodology section, and DOD sections are consistent between promotion and ordinary brief generation. All tests pass.
